symptom: A synthetic ambient Array.prototype.push replacement can substitute an ACTIVE anchor for a validated REVOKED witness or settlement anchor during policy collection, or erase a valid anchor, changing the untrusted policy-consistency result. No independent trust verification or production path is involved.
lesson: A strict descriptor/shape check does not protect an intermediate policy-anchor array when a later append uses ambient mutable Array.prototype.push. A forged ACTIVE anchor can launder a revoked caller-supplied policy anchor into a structurally consistent but still UNTRUSTED result; dropping anchors can also create false denials.
guardrail: Reuse the previously recorded push-mutation guardrail: copy each validated anchor by indexed assignment into a fresh local array, and regression-test both revoked-key substitution and dropped valid anchors under synthetic Array.prototype.push overrides. Keep independentAuthorityVerified=false and scoringAuthorized=false; no external signature, clock or trust-root authentication is implied.
